ground_truth.title: Info - Ultimate Graphics Card Comparison Guide (2025)  NVIDIA & AMD Desktop GPUs
ground_truth.author: SamuelMIz
ground_truth.main_content:
Hey everyone!

After constantly helping friends and fellow PC builders choose the right GPU, I’ve put together a comprehensive GPU comparison post that highlights the most important specs and differences between current-gen AMD and NVIDIA cards.

Whether you're gaming, rendering, or building a powerful workstation, this guide breaks things down simply and visually.

Link to GPU Comparison Table (With Filters & Charts):​

Key Comparison Categories:​

Memory​

VRAM Size (4GB–24GB)

Type: GDDR6 / GDDR6X / HBM2

Bus Width & Bandwidth (bit & GB/s)

Performance Benchmarks​

1080p / 1440p / 4K Avg FPS (in top titles)

Ray Tracing (on/off) performance

DLSS / FSR Support & Gen Version

Architecture​

CUDA / Stream Processors

Clock Speeds (Base & Boost)

Lithography (e.g., 5nm / 6nm)

PCIe Gen Compatibility

Power & Cooling​

TDP / Recommended PSU

Number of Fans & Heatsink Type

Custom vs Reference Models (Founders Edition vs AIBs)

Physical Specs​

Length (in mm/inches)

Slot Width (2-slot, 2.5-slot, 3-slot)

Required case clearance

Top Picks (Q2 2025)​

Budget Pick Notes
Entry (≤$300) RX 7600 XT Great for 1080p ultra
Mid-Range ($400–600) RTX 4070 Super Sweet spot for 1440p
High-End (>$800) RTX 4090 Unreal 4K/AI performance
🛠 Workstation Radeon Pro W7800 ECC support, great for 3D/design

What To Consider​

Gaming only? Focus on VRAM + FPS performance

Productivity & AI work? Prioritize CUDA cores, VRAM, and driver support.

Small case? Check the length and power connector clearance!
Let me know if you want me to add a specific card to the chart or if you spot any outdated specs I'm updating it regularly.

Happy building!

Samuel Miz

Hey everyone!

After constantly helping friends and fellow PC builders choose the *right* GPU, I’ve put together a **comprehensive GPU comparison post** that highlights the **most important specs and differences** between current-gen AMD and NVIDIA cards.

Whether you're gaming, rendering, or building a powerful workstation, this guide breaks things down simply and visually.

#### Link to GPU Comparison Table (With Filters & Charts):​

### Key Comparison Categories:​

#### Memory​

- VRAM Size (4GB–24GB)

- Type: GDDR6 / GDDR6X / HBM2

- Bus Width & Bandwidth (bit & GB/s)

#### Performance Benchmarks​

- 1080p / 1440p / 4K Avg FPS (in top titles)

- Ray Tracing (on/off) performance

- DLSS / FSR Support & Gen Version

#### Architecture​

- CUDA / Stream Processors

- Clock Speeds (Base & Boost)

- Lithography (e.g., 5nm / 6nm)

- PCIe Gen Compatibility

#### Power & Cooling​

- TDP / Recommended PSU

- Number of Fans & Heatsink Type

- Custom vs Reference Models (Founders Edition vs AIBs)

#### Physical Specs​

- Length (in mm/inches)

- Slot Width (2-slot, 2.5-slot, 3-slot)

- Required case clearance

### Top Picks (Q2 2025)​

| Budget | Pick | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry (≤$300) | **RX 7600 XT** | Great for 1080p ultra |
| Mid-Range ($400–600) | **RTX 4070 Super** | Sweet spot for 1440p |
| High-End (>$800) | **RTX 4090** | Unreal 4K/AI performance |
| 🛠 Workstation | **Radeon Pro W7800** | ECC support, great for 3D/design |

### What To Consider​

- **Gaming only?** Focus on VRAM + FPS performance

- **Productivity & AI work?** Prioritize CUDA cores, VRAM, and driver support.

- **Small case?** Check the length and power connector clearance!
**Let me know** if you want me to add a specific card to the chart or if you spot any outdated specs I'm updating it regularly.

Happy building!

Samuel Miz
